okf_version.title: OKF spec version
okf_version.description: The Open Knowledge Format spec version this bundle targets.

path.title: Bundle directory
path.description: The OKF bundle's root directory, relative to the project root.

profile.title: Profile name
profile.description: The named profile merged under `DEFAULTS < profile < file`, or "none" to disable profile merging.

bundle.title: Bundle location and profile
bundle.description: Where the OKF bundle lives and which profile merges under it.

required.title: Required frontmatter keys
required.description: Frontmatter keys every concept must carry, beyond the spec's required set.

concepts.title: Concept-level requirements
concepts.description: Requirements every concept in the bundle must satisfy, beyond the spec's own.

default_stale_after.title: Stale-after duration
default_stale_after.description: How long a concept may go unedited before lint `stale` fires. Accepts "<n>h", "<n>d", "<n>w", or Effect's "<n> <unit>" long form.

agent.title: Agent actor
agent.description: The actor id an agent writes as `generated.by`.

humans.title: Human actors
humans.description: Actor ids for the humans working in this bundle, "human:<id>" form.

actors.title: Actor identities
actors.description: Who authors and verifies concepts in this bundle.

broken_links.title: broken-links
broken_links.description: A link in a concept's body or frontmatter does not resolve. Default "warn".

missing_index.title: missing-index
missing_index.description: A concept-holding directory has no index.md. Default "warn".

unknown_type.title: unknown-type
unknown_type.description: A concept's type is not one of the config's declared [types.<Name>]. Default "error", off when no types are declared.

required_key_missing.title: required-key-missing
required_key_missing.description: A concept is missing a frontmatter key its type or concepts.required requires. Default "error".

field_value_unknown.title: field-value-unknown
field_value_unknown.description: A frontmatter field's value is not one of its declared values. Default "error".

require_verified_unmet.title: require-verified-unmet
require_verified_unmet.description: A concept whose type sets require_verified = true carries no verified entry. Default "error".

family_invalid.title: family-invalid
family_invalid.description: A concept's declared family does not match an accepted shape. Default "error".

computation_runtime_missing.title: computation-runtime-missing
computation_runtime_missing.description: A referenced computation's runtime is not available. Default "error".

footnote_source_unknown.title: footnote-source-unknown
footnote_source_unknown.description: A footnote's source does not resolve. Default "warn".

log_frontmatter.title: log-frontmatter
log_frontmatter.description: log.md carries frontmatter, which the spec reserves against. Default "warn".

actor_prefix_unknown.title: actor-prefix-unknown
actor_prefix_unknown.description: An actor's prefix is not human, process, or a producer shape. Default "info".

legacy_timestamp.title: legacy-timestamp
legacy_timestamp.description: A concept uses the legacy timestamp field instead of generated.at. Default "info".

config_unknown_key.title: config-unknown-key
config_unknown_key.description: The config file declares a top-level key the schema does not recognize. Default "warn".

stale.title: stale
stale.description: A concept has gone unedited past lifecycle.default_stale_after. Default "info".

walk_unreadable.title: walk-unreadable
walk_unreadable.description: A directory in the bundle could not be read while walking. Default "warn".

generated_at_drift.title: generated-at-drift
generated_at_drift.description: A committed concept's generated.at is missing or does not match its last body-changing commit, and is not otherwise authoritative (issue #19: a stamp recorded during the unchanged-body run survives a squash/rebase merge). Default "warn".

lint.title: Lint severities
lint.description: Per-code severity overrides. Any key omitted keeps its default.

description.description: One-sentence summary of what this type represents.

guidance.description: Longer guidance shown to an authoring agent or human writing a concept of this type.

required.description: Frontmatter keys a concept of this type must carry, beyond `concepts.required`.

require_verified.description: Whether a concept of this type must carry a `verified` entry to satisfy lint `require-verified-unmet`.

values.description: The allowed values, each with a one-sentence description.

kind.description: "path": the value is a concept id or file path, not one of an enumerated set.

fields.description: Extension fields this type's frontmatter may declare.

types.title: Concept type declarations
types.description: One entry per concept type, keyed by type name.

description.description: One-sentence summary of what applying this tag means.

tags.title: Tag declarations
tags.description: One entry per tag, keyed by tag name.

title: okfit config
description:
okfit's TOML config file (OKF spec 4.2). Unrecognized top-level keys are preserved verbatim and produce a config-unknown-key warning, never a validation error.
https://github.com/spencerbeggs/okfit#configuration
